title: DryRunJobResponseAttributes
description: Attributes for a dry run job response

completed_at.description: When the job completed processing (only present when status is completed or failed)

error_message.description: Error message if the job failed (only present when status is failed)

started_at.description: When the job started processing (only present when status is running, completed, or failed)

status.description: The current status of the dry run job

delete_images.description: Delete images no longer matching the policy. False by default.

schedule_frequency_hours.description: The frequency of the import policy in hours.

DryRunPolicyResult.description: The results of a dry run policy execution

images_to_delete.description: List of images grouped by repositories that would be deleted based on the policy rules (only populated when delete_images is enabled)

images_to_import.description: List of images grouped by repositories that would be imported based on the policy rules

total_images_processed.description: Total number of images that were evaluated during the policy test, including both matching and non-matching images

observed_at.description: When the image was first observed

PolicyComponent.description: A component policy, an overall policy is made up of one or more component policies combined in various ways.

RepositoryGroup.description: A repository with its matching tags grouped together
